steps.name: flow-polish
steps.summary: Judge dead ends removed. D3: [Try again] and Try another place right under the order number, scrolled into view (DemoEndCard); Touch vs talk hides this order's seconds unless people's touch times are beside them (CompareCard). Instant feedback: phone 'Working…' on send (useChat sentAt removed); phone pings /api/ping with working true/false (chat busy or voice thinking), server keeps public Session.phoneWorkingAt (phone only, heartbeat leaves it), kiosk toolbar row on K2/K3/K6 shows KIBO-blue 'KIBO 처리하고 있어요 · Working…' while < 20 s old and before paying (kiboWorking in src/lib/kiosk/timers.ts). [Yes, pay now] disabled only while its own command is in flight (server confirm rules unchanged). Choices show prices from menu data (choicePrice) and upsell gets [No thanks]/[괜찮아요] (declineLabel), hidden locally after the tap. Instructions: no 'confirm card'/'확인 카드', no 'please wait'/'I am adding' for done changes; eval fails replies with internalWords (scripts/grounding.ts; learned kiosks may say adding). Phone: cart summary pill above the dock when the card is out of view (phone mode only), mic shrinks to 56px while the field has focus (Dock compactWhileTyping), shorter MALO placeholder. D1 below 900px: laptop note first, steps without left/right. /app hint '6 digits'. Landscape /kiosk and /demo own-phone: full-height canvas plus slim status column (no QR or code in PairingPanel). Tests: service, timers, choices, grounding, instructions; e2e/flow-polish.spec.ts; pairing, compare, stream-idle specs updated; QA states K3-kibo-working, P3-upsell, P3-typing-ko-large, P3-cart-summary-ko-large, D1-intro-phone. Eval 42/44 on Vertex (2 from the first too-broad check), re-run 3/3. Issues I-210..I-216 logged, I-133 and I-141 fixed.

steps.name: learn-visible
steps.summary: KIBO Learn made visible. Readable kiosk: the learned page keeps the learner's 1080 width but is laid out 1120-1600 tall (pageFrame in new src/lib/bridge/replayView.ts), so /learned/doughhouse draws it 0.80x at 1440x900 (0.64x at 1280x720; /demo column is width-bound at 0.52x, smallest page text 14.5px). Visible replay: runPlan takes onTap (label and box of each click about to happen, awaited, never for skipped or refused steps); createBridge numbers taps and returns them with change, cartBefore, kioskTotal and reported; ms leaves the host's pause out. LearnedKioskHost draws a numbered KIBO-blue mark with one 400ms ring (kibo-tap utility, none with reduced motion) on the target and waits 350ms per tap (E2E knob window.__kiboTapPauseMs). replayCaption: 'KIBO is tapping the kiosk... tap 3: 라지', 'checking the kiosk total...', then 'Added: Pepperoni. KIBO tapped 피자 -> ... · 7 taps · kiosk total 23,400원 ✓ matches' only after the server's bridgeStatus for that command, or plainly that nothing was added; 'KIBO is working...' hides only results older than the current AI turn; old 'Done on the kiosk' removed (I-221). /learned/<kiosk> now has KIBO's side panel: intro in English and Korean (our development kiosk), QR, 6-digit code with address, phone status, replay line, link to /learn (I-222); /demo keeps a strip. /learn: cards show a cropped sheet of the recorded screenshot with caption (cover.crop, tested), file paths in one grey Sources line, new 'How KIBO gets onto a real kiosk' section (direct adapter; script tag, kiosk-browser extension, WebView injection; native roadmap; no partnerships); replay puts action and controls before the picture on phones (I-199) and adds [Larger picture] (I-198). Kept the 10-13 Doughhouse trace (no new Gemini run), labelled as recorded before the restyle. Tests: replayView.test.ts (17), recipe/bridge onTap tests, runs crop test, e2e learn.spec (phone fold, zoom, section), QA states learned-widget-tapping, index-cards-third, index-real-kiosks, replay-larger-picture. Docs: UX (C2c, LK row, L1, L2), ARCHITECTURE, KIBO_LEARN, UI_GUIDE, UI_QA, TESTING (bridge row notes the pause), SECURITY. Issues: I-096, I-198, I-199 fixed; I-221, I-222 logged fixed; I-223 open (start button under the cart bar at the shorter layout). ACs: lint, build, unit 1005, e2e 46 passed (17 @live skipped), qa:ui 45 passed 0 H; evidence files rewritten by E2E restored.

steps.name: any-language
steps.summary: Phone AI speaks any of 9 languages; screens stay ko/en. src/lib/i18n/languages.ts: SPEECH_LANGUAGES ko en ja zh es vi fr th id with Live codes (cmn-CN for zh), uiLocale, aiOnly, lt() translating only mic label, say-yes line, [Yes, pay now], [Pick more], insert-card title, order/reference number (AiLanguageProvider/useAiText in src/components/phone/language.tsx). AppBar language button opens a picker dialog (Screens and AI: 한국어/English; AI only: the 7 others, each in its own words with the English name); choice saved in phone settings, sent as optional `language` to /api/live-token, /api/chat and the relay hello (strict schemas, so both services must be redeployed together, I-227). Instructions: speak the chosen language, reply in the language the user writes; item names never translated (grounding unchanged); vague requests the data can narrow (names, categories, kcal, badges) get offerChoices instead of a staff call, 'spice level' removed from the staff list. Dine bug I-224: command replies carry dineOption, tool results pass it, instructions say the latest one wins, and the phone tells an open Live session via a PHONE_NOTE clientContent turn when a tap sets it (src/lib/voice/dineNote.ts, tellDine in useLiveVoice). Tile word-split I-225: latinFit in MenuScreen sizes long English names to fit, new H check splitWords on kiosk canvases, QA states K3-rail-menu-en, K3-rail-cards-en, P-lang-picker. Evals: 12 colloquial + 14 language cases (replyLanguage check in scripts/grounding.ts, no AI); full run 69/70 on Vertex (earlier set 44/44, colloquial 11/12 then the one case's expectation fixed and re-run 1/1, language 14/14), evals/results/2026-10-14T12-19, 12-36. npm run voice:languages: 18/18 setups replied in-language on API key and Vertex us-central1, typed turn only (evidence/live-languages.json). Vertex language page not read (no web access), logged I-226; SOURCES G1b, TESTING, DECK_FACTS, ARCHITECTURE, UX, UI_GUIDE, UI_QA, PRD updated. ACs: lint, build, unit 1029, eval (run 12:19 on the final instructions), e2e/any-language.spec.ts, qa:ui 0 H.

steps.name: fast-feel
steps.summary: Text agent skips the second model call when it adds nothing: new src/lib/agent/quickReply.ts builds the reply from fixed ko/en sentences over the tool results and menu data (lineLabel names, formatWon, phone payNow label; ticket wording) when every first-round call succeeded and is setDineOption/addToCart/updateCart/removeFromCart/undoLastChange/requestCheckout/confirmCheckout, no upsell, direct kiosk, no model text beside the calls, and plainRequest says the message is in the screens' language (ko Hangul; en ASCII with English words) with no question; otherwise the model writes the reply (failure, choice, staff, upsell, learned kiosk, question, AI-only language). runChat wires it (round 0 only). Payment rule unchanged. Tests first: quickReply.test.ts (7), chat.test.ts (2 new, round-cap test given a question). Eval records per-model-call ms (rounds, callsPerRequest, oneCallWithTools) and fills codes of templated calls from actions. Vertex, 70 cases: before 70/70, 206 calls, median 7.6 s p90 19.3 s (12-42); after 69/70, 172 calls, 23 requests with one call, median 7.1 s p90 26.9 s (12-59, tail from 20-31 s Vertex single calls); templated turns paired 7.4 s -> 3.2 s (subset rerun 2.7 s, 13-18). Failure l-es-ambiguous-picker-en not on the template path, flaky 2/4 (I-228). Streaming not built. evidence/fast-feel.json, TESTING row, ARCHITECTURE /api/chat. Cost per order not re-measured. ACs: lint, build, unit 1038, eval.
